latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — instantly convert text or documents into AI-generated shareable videos.

- Supports text prompts and document uploads (TXT, DOCX, PDF; up to 500MB).
- Cloud-based video rendering with 1080p MP4 output in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple onboarding: automatic cloud connection and free trial credits.
- Flexible user prompts for editing, exporting, and previewing.
- Session-based workflow for iterative edits and batch processing.
- Credits, file limits, and error handling clearly described.
